title: Hanged on a Tree
aka: cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree
lead: Deuteronomy commands that the body of an executed criminal hung on a tree be buried before night, "for a man who is hanged is cursed by God" (Deuteronomy 21:22–23). Joshua follows the rule (Joshua 8:29; 10:26–27), the Dead Sea Scrolls apply it to crucifixion, the Gospels note that Jesus' body was taken down before the Sabbath (John 19:31), and Paul says Christ became a curse for us (Galatians 3:13).
